title: Redrox`s Emerald Tools And Armour
description: This mods add emerald armour and tools in minecraft which we can get by smithing!
body:
Emerald Armour and tools mods which is my first mod made in MCREATOR thanks to them for free mod creation and can get by smithing iron armours and tools by using emerald block as smithing template and iron tools to be smithed and emerald. For help check gallery.
It is my first mod so i dont know how to port to lower version😭🙏
